title: Choose the visual world (re-roll · simpler)
question: Steer: keep it a bit simple. Same product (multi-session desk, architecture + report + DEMO metrics). Previous options discarded.

options.label: Quiet research console
options.lineage: calm operator console · light monochrome + one accent
options.body: Simple desk UI that still proves the product: left session list, main column for compose → short stage step-rail (plan · research×N · normalize · verify · final) → report. Metrics as one compact footer (wall time, stages, fan-out, verdict, DEMO tokens)—resume-readable, not a dashboard wall. Pale cool ground, ink black type, single blue accent for running/active. First viewport is almost empty: pick or start a session, type a query, run. Risk: too plain for a portfolio unless the stage rail and report feel intentional.

options.label: Teletext pages
options.body: Architecture and report as numbered “pages” (100 compose, 200 live run, 300 report, 400 metrics). High-contrast limited palette, blocky clarity, session as channel. Very simple graphic grammar; strong resume novelty without ornament. Risk: can feel gimmicky if the page metaphor fights multi-session tasks.

options.label: Hard edges desk
options.body: Thick borders, flat color blocks, no soft chrome. Sessions, stage rail, report, and metrics each a clear slab. Easy to scan for interviewers; little decoration. Risk: loud branding if color is overdone—keep blocks few and quiet.
